milestones.description: Implementar modelos/persistencia/revisiones de campañas/plantillas CRM/segmentos.
Demostrar CRUD regla/campaña y persistencia tras recarga con audiencia vacía explicada.
Demostrar SQL histórico campaña/regla/evaluaciones con preservación.
Completar segmentos guardados/semántica Scentra distinguiendo plantilla CRM/Meta.
Aceptar comportamiento completo por rol/versión en SQL/UI actual.
Aceptar criterio completo en alcance canónico, con evidencia/límites/reversión revisados.

criteria.requirement: portar activadores y flujos de varios pasos: condiciones, esperas persistidas, horarios, salida por respuesta, pausa y reglas por etapa/programa.

milestones.description: Implementar reglas por programa/etapa/condiciones/plantilla con revisiones.
Implementar evaluación/preparación durable y registrar cuatro resultados históricos reales.
Implementar flujo multietapa con esperas/horarios/transiciones versionadas persistidos.
Integrar editor y salida/pausa por respuesta/etapa/programa/handoff.
Probar reinicio/opt-out/cambios concurrentes por paso con dispatcher aceptado.
Aceptar criterio completo en alcance canónico, con evidencia/límites/reversión revisados.

criteria.requirement: incorporar simulación/preflight, versiones, A/B y medición donde exista equivalente; conectar al mismo dispatcher validado en P7.

milestones.description: Conservar preview/preflight de audiencia y operaciones locales con estado real.
Definir equivalencia real de versiones/A-B/medición de campañas en Scentra.
Implementar simulación/versiones/variantes de campaña, distinto de A-B de agentes.
Conectar dispatcher P7 aceptado y comprobar atribución/medición de variantes.
Aceptar criterio completo en alcance canónico, con evidencia/límites/reversión revisados.

criteria.requirement: **Cierre:** avances de flujo sobreviven a reinicio; un cambio de etapa, respuesta, handoff o baja cancela lo que corresponda; no hay envíos duplicados por reejecución de worker. **Reversión:** pausar versión/flujo, conservar ejecuciones y reactivar una versión anterior sólo tras revisar trabajos pendientes.

milestones.description: Conservar ejecuciones/revisiones durables de evaluación/preparación sin envío ni flujo ficticio.
Probar avance/esperas multietapa que sobreviven reinicio real.
Probar cancelación por etapa/respuesta/handoff/baja con workers concurrentes.
Probar reversión a flujo anterior sin borrar pendientes ni duplicar envíos.
Cerrar P8 y P5/P6/P7: evaluación local no equivale a remarketing completo.

Concurrent durable workers with tenant isolation and recorded errors

semantic_contract.fields: Exact fields, annotations and default expressions are enumerated in schema_contract.models TemplateIn/TemplatePatchIn.
semantic_contract.storage: saas_message_templates; source internal; default template_scope crm; string status/channel, no enum.
semantic_contract.meta_boundary: Local approved is not provider approval. UI directs official Meta broadcast templates to Mensajeria masiva.
semantic_contract.fallback: No usable blocks -> rendered body. Media without id/url can become caption text.
semantic_contract.catalog_gap: customer_email is listed in parameter catalog but absent from _conversation_vars.

nodes.label: Saved segment and preview input shapes

semantic_contract.schema: filters_json dict[str,Any] without typed nested grammar.
semantic_contract.target: saas_conversations with tenant_id and deleted_at IS NULL.
semantic_contract.counts: Create/filter PATCH persists audience_count. Preview computes count. Lists return saved count. Campaign preflight only recounts a saved segment when audience_count<=0.
semantic_contract.unknown_fields: Ignored by _segment_where. No program selector appears.

nodes.label: Campaign items CRUD and activation gate

semantic_contract.audience: Selected segment produces count; no segment -> count0.
semantic_contract.activation: Create/PATCH scheduled or running requires preflight.ready; HTTP409 campaign_preflight_failed otherwise.
semantic_contract.schedule: DTO scheduled_at string is cast to timestamp; UI datetime-local has no separate timezone field.
semantic_contract.worker_limit: Neither listed worker reads campaign items in saas_campaigns. No campaign recipient enumeration/dispatch loop appears in this router/two workers.

semantic_contract.storage: saas_crm_trigger_versions; ON CONFLICT tenant/trigger/version DO NOTHING.
semantic_contract.behavior: Create/copy records initial snapshot. PATCH records before_update, increments current version, records result. Restore selects tenant/trigger/version snapshot, preflights, records before_restore, replaces fields and increments current version into a new snapshot.
semantic_contract.flow_gap: Flow PATCH increments version_number, no flow snapshot/restore route or enrollment version pin in corpus.
semantic_contract.campaign_gap: Campaign CRUD has no version increment/snapshot/restore in corpus.
semantic_contract.pending_gap: Trigger restore does not review/cancel delayed scheduled messages.

nodes.label: Trigger copy and case-insensitive name uniqueness

semantic_contract.name: request name or source.name + copia; lower(name) check within tenant+target channel; suffix2,3,... respecting160char.
semantic_contract.gate: Preflight rejects active non-ready copy; records trigger_copied snapshot/preflight.
semantic_contract.channel_gap: Original template ids stay unchanged on cross-channel copy; no template remapping.

semantic_contract.status: ready if ready, otherwise blocked if high failure, otherwise warning
flow_checks: each dict step template draft/approved high
semantic_contract.limits: Does not fully validate nested action/condition/event grammar, channel alignment, template scope, reply_comment template mode, step order/wait, valid zone/time or future schedule. No consent/provider approval established. Empty trigger conditions are a medium failure and can still be ready.
semantic_contract.write_gate: Campaign scheduled/running, active trigger and active flow writes reject non-ready.

semantic_contract.saved: Saved preflight writes preflight_json/last_preflight_at; campaign also activation_blocked_reason. Draft preflight creates run without entity id.

semantic_contract.runtime: _event_matches rejects trigger_type none/tag_changed. message_flow excludes comments; comment_flow requires comment. received/sent/comment use event_type aliases and optional flow_event filters. No autonomous time/tag-change producer appears in the listed workers.
semantic_contract.time_logic: These types still use message matching; event_type=time alone does not match received/sent/comment.

nodes.label: Executed condition grammar and legacy aliases

semantic_contract.container: match or mode all/any, defaults all; .conditions, legacy .all or .contains -> check_words. Filter non-dict conditions; empty conditions match true.

template_sent_status.template_id: required for sent; empty id matches not_sent
template_sent_status.evidence: Existence of local outbound saas_messages payload.template_id, without receipt/delivery check.

current_tag.tag: normalized exact member of split CSV/list tags

nodes.label: Inclusive local quiet window and global union

semantic_contract.runtime: Enabled quiet window blocks when schedule matcher is true. Inclusive start/end; same-day start<=end or overnight start>end. Day is current local weekday. Invalid IANA timezone silently falls back to America/Bogota; malformed HH:MM uses fallback and numeric hours/minutes clamp.
semantic_contract.global_scope: All enabled all/channel and all/entity_type matching rows are considered; first blocked row blocks. No specificity override.
semantic_contract.effects: Immediate triggers skip events; remarketing defers by retry_minutes; delayed triggers defer30min on global quiet only.
semantic_contract.preflight: Nonempty start/end/day configuration check, not valid HH:MM/IANA or current-time eligibility.

nodes.label: Recipient SHA256 bucket and action override

semantic_contract.assignment: int(SHA256(recipient or anonymous).hexdigest()[:8],16)%100. Cumulative integer weights clamp1..100, default100/variant_count; last variant fallback.
semantic_contract.stability: No entity id/version/experiment salt in hash; same recipient bucket across entities. Config changes can change selected variant.
semantic_contract.override: Selected template_id/reply_text patches every action before type dispatch. Flow-level selected template can replace the template in every flow step.
semantic_contract.preflight: Enabled requires variants (medium). Supplied template ids must exist draft/approved (high). Total weight<=0 or80..120 accepted (low).

semantic_contract.outcome: queued if result.ok else failed. Successful non-send/scheduled actions can yield queued with no outbound id.
semantic_contract.report: Groups variant_key/template_id ->events/queued/failed/last_seen_at. No provider delivery/read/reply/conversion measurement.
semantic_contract.version_step: Recorder has no dedicated version or flow step identity field.

nodes.label: Render and enqueue CRM template sequence

semantic_contract.sequence: Render blocks, UUID response_group_id, sequence_number and total_chunks.
semantic_contract.media: image/video/audio/document payload with id/url/mime/filename; no provider call in queue functions.
semantic_contract.not_forwarded: Template UI delay_ms and action remarketing_flow_id/remarketing_step_order do not enter shown sender block_payload.
semantic_contract.status_limit: Queued local rows do not mean external sent/delivered/read. Dispatcher implementation is outside corpus.

nodes.label: Persist local text and outbox row
Persist local media and outbox row
Ordered action effects and recorded failures

semantic_contract.errors: Unknown type ->unknown_action_type. Exceptions ->action error; later actions continue; final ok iff no failed actions.
semantic_contract.reply_comment: mode template uses sender; other modes queue literal reply_text/text/ai_prompt/fallback after variable render. No AI generator call in this action.
semantic_contract.change_tag: CSV/list tags plus optional tag; add/remove/set with normalized dedup.
semantic_contract.configure_conversation: takeover bool/on/off tokens; clear_ai_state or ai_state patch.
semantic_contract.change_contact_status: Whitelist customer_type/payment_status/crm_stage/intent; unsupported field falls back customer_type; status required.
semantic_contract.notify_admins: Writes trigger.notify_admins audit event with rendered message/conversation_id. phones unused; no notification transport call here.
semantic_contract.extract_conversation_info: Concatenates last3..30 local messages into trigger_extract summary, no semantic AI extraction.
semantic_contract.assistant_flags: assistant_enabled/assistant_message_type saved/read, not used to branch this worker execution.

semantic_contract.selection: Active channel-matching tenant triggers, priority ASC then updated_at ASC.
semantic_contract.cooldown: Any recent execution, including errors, blocks; plain existence query, not idempotency key.
semantic_contract.effects: Actions then execution status/error/details, last_run_at. stop_on_match stops subsequent triggers even on action error.
semantic_contract.block_ai: execution details true only if flag and action status ok.
semantic_contract.concurrency_limit: No explicit unique input execution claim in this function. Constraints in other files were not inspected.

semantic_contract.input: Exact schema in TriggerSimulateIn. trigger_id takes precedence over submitted trigger.
semantic_contract.context: Optional conversation_id loads local real context, otherwise synthetic zero-UUID demo.
semantic_contract.actions: Preview selected variant, template_found/status/would_queue count, reply sample/details. Does not call _execute_actions or enqueue.
semantic_contract.ready_gap: all gate checks only; unsupported actions/template status/preview errors not added. is_active not checked.
semantic_contract.block_ai_gap: flag AND conditions_ok may be true while matched=false due event/quiet/takeover/cooldown.
semantic_contract.saved_draft_ui: Existing trigger simulation sends trigger_id and no draft. Saved preflight endpoints review saved rows, ignoring unsaved editor changes. flow_event both sent as event_kind both falls through received matcher.

nodes.label: Claim and process delayed trigger message

semantic_contract.creation: schedule_message inserts saas_trigger_scheduled_messages tenant/trigger/conversation/template/channel/recipient, source payload and UTC now+delay_minutes clamp0..129600.
semantic_contract.claim: pending+run_at<=NOW+live conversation; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ->processing, attempts+1.
semantic_contract.due_checks: Runtime allowed, current conversation, template id, GLOBAL trigger quiet hours. No load/recheck of saved trigger active/version/conditions/local quiet/takeover.
semantic_contract.success: Sender queues local rows, scheduled row immediately marked sent/sent_at; queued stat increments.
semantic_contract.failure: failed+last_error; no failed-row retry selection shown.

semantic_contract.logic: AND supplied checks. tag substring in CSV, city/intent substring, others equal; takeover bool/on/off aliases.
semantic_contract.candidates: Same channel, nondeleted, inactivity >=resume_after; active/hold/completed enrollment excluded.
semantic_contract.handoff: Takeover blocks enroll/send unless a takeover key exists in entry rules. Key presence bypasses default check.
semantic_contract.gaps: No program predicate, response event exit, per-step conditions or entry-stage mismatch exit shown.

nodes.label: Ordered template steps and durable waits

semantic_contract.order: Sort integer order. Next strictly greater. Missing current order falls back first. No branch/step-type evaluator.
semantic_contract.wait: Clamp0..525600; first wait from enrollment, next wait from previous successful local queue.
semantic_contract.action: Every step send_template, plus optional A/B event. stage_name never read by worker.
semantic_contract.version: Current mutable flow loaded on each due run. Enrollment schema and flow SELECT have no version pin.

semantic_contract.claim: active+due next_run_at+live conversation; FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ->processing.
semantic_contract.inactive_flow: hold, flow_not_active, next_run_at+60min; selector only picks active, no hold->active path shown.
semantic_contract.missing_template: No step template id ->failed; send failure ->active retry.
semantic_contract.success: last_sent after local queue, next order and wait; final completed with NULL next_run_at.
semantic_contract.runtime_ddl: Worker calls CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS. Source observation only, no authority to run this in CBN.
semantic_contract.counter_gaps: enrolled increments even after DO NOTHING; database final success marks completed but returned queued branch does not increment completed statistic.

semantic_contract.template: Text/media/audio/document, variables, local preview, delay_ms input; scope distinct from official Meta.
semantic_contract.segment: Create+preview+list. Router PATCH exists but panel has no segment edit action.
semantic_contract.campaign: Create+draft preflight+list. Router PATCH exists but panel has no existing campaign edit action.
semantic_contract.flow: Create/edit active/paused, template/wait steps, quiet/A-B/report, saved preflight, manual process; no enrollment hold/resume UI.
semantic_contract.trigger: Create/update/copy/delete/active toggle, conditions/actions, preflight/simulation, quiet/A-B report and version restore.

nodes.label: Trigger builder, simulator, versions and A/B
Shared dispatcher and preserved external acceptance bounds

semantic_contract.transport: P7 docs state one C10 queue/dispatcher; no legacy campaigns worker/API mounted; POST revalidation and accepted/sent/delivered/read/failed distinctions.
semantic_contract.mapping: Canonical contacts/C10 identities/declared programs; no-contact/human/closed excluded. Commercial payment/type/intent are not invented in educational model.
semantic_contract.template: Local CRM approved distinct from fresh provider-approved WhatsApp template/account/credential.
semantic_contract.preservation: Earlier images/bases/profiles/volumes retained; uncertainty/receipts preserved during reviewed reversal; no destructive down migrations.
semantic_contract.external_limit: No domain/apps real. P4/P7 remain82.29%; no provider/institutional acceptance claim.
